title: Driver Compensation Reversal Schedule: Lost-Time Removal on Cleaning and Damage Fees Level Corrections
content:
**Rule.** The lost-time removal of a correction of a charged Cleaning and Damage Fees cleaning fee depends on the two levels and the evidence on file: when the level moved from assumes the vehicle was taken offline, the level moved to does not, and a professional cleaning document is on the evidence ledger, it is the daily lost-time removal rate for each calendar day from the reported trip's drop-off date through the date of the latest professional cleaning document, both days counted; when the level moved from assumes the vehicle was taken offline, the level moved to does not, and no professional cleaning document is on file, it is the daily lost-time removal rate for one day; otherwise there is no lost-time removal.

The daily lost-time removal rate is $30.00. The removal is subtracted from the fee carried to the level moved to, the result never going below zero.

## Offline assumption of the cleaning levels

| Cleaning level | Vehicle assumed taken offline |
|---|---|
| Cleaning Fee Level 1 (Minor) | No |
| Cleaning Fee Level 2 (Moderate) | No |
| Cleaning Fee Level 3 (Significant) | Yes |
| Cleaning Fee Level 4 (Major) | Yes |

(The damage levels also assume the vehicle was taken offline.)

## When a removal applies

| Level moved from | Level moved to | Professional cleaning document on the ledger | Lost-time removal |
|---|---|---|---|
| Level 3 or 4 | Level 1 or 2 | yes | $30.00 for each calendar day from the drop-off date through the latest document date, both counted |
| Level 3 or 4 | Level 1 or 2 | no | $30.00, one day |
| Level 4 | Level 3 | any | none |
| Level 2 | Level 1 | any | none |

The drop-off date is the date of the drop-off moment on the trip record in Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares); a professional cleaning document is a cleaning receipt submission on the assessment's evidence ledger, dated by its submission.

## Case (hypothetical)

A fee moved from Cleaning Fee Level 4 (Major) to Cleaning Fee Level 2 (Moderate) on a trip that dropped off on 10 May, with a cleaning receipt submission dated 12 May: 10, 11 and 12 May are 3 days, so the removal is $90.00. With a fee of $72.00 carried to the level moved to, $72.00 less $90.00 is below zero and the result is $0.00.
